scope: Separate CPU-only AR16 QAT200 pilot; not listened to or measured on N1.
decision: Hold as unapproved diagnostic. Validation KL remains approximately35% above approved AR17; no quality equivalence or speed result is inferred.

selection.scope:
Select one redundant layer on training contexts for a separate QAT pilot.

This creates an unapproved initialization, not a speed or listening result.
Protected original teacher feature anchors are retained. Decoder files are not
read or changed. Quantization-aware scoring is a training surrogate only.

history.scope: Teacher forcing only; no free-generation approval

conversion.unchanged: All other checkpoint tensor values, including bias/norm/embedding

evaluation.scope:
Evaluate immutable AR checkpoints on original-teacher heldout contexts.

QAT is a training surrogate, not native bitwise inference or a voice-quality
rating. This script never selects layers, trains parameters or measures RTF.
